description: 重试语义下的 Timeout 边界输入

overallInvocationDeadline.description: 整个逻辑 Tool Invocation 拥有唯一的整体 Deadline
overallInvocationDeadline.invariant: overall deadline 不受重试次数影响

perAttemptDeadline.description: 每次重试尝试可拥有更短的技术超时

remainingDeadline.description: 每次重试前计算剩余 Deadline = overallDeadline - timeElapsed
remainingDeadline.handover: 通过 context.WithTimeout(remaining) 传递给下次重试
remainingDeadline.note: 当 remaining <= 0 时不再重试，直接返回 timed_out

sideEffectUncertainty.note: 超时后 Provider 可能已部分执行（如消息已发送但响应未到），Retry 必须标记 sideEffectRisk
sideEffectUncertainty.mapping: timeout + sideEffectRisk → indeterminate outcome preserved by existing model if exists
